speaker: margery_pell
text: A man had it from the court post. I have brought it with the box, before the jig.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Say it, then, before the yard does.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Wednesday, at six in the morning, four galleys put men ashore in Mount's Bay.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Mousehole is burned. And Newlyn. And Penzance. And the church at Paul, on the hill.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Four galleys, or forty?

speaker: george_bryan
text: If it were forty we'd not have played to the end.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Galleys burn and go. They cannot lie on that coast.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That is more than the churchyard had. The churchyard had a shore, and no town.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Let me dance the old woman before they settle it. A house that will not settle can still laugh.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: They laughed. I had it of them anyway.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Four is a number a man can say. Forty is the number a yard prefers.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Nobody knows more than those places and those four ships. We will not add a town, and we will not add a hull.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Mousehole, Newlyn, Penzance, and Paul. I will keep that order.

speaker: george_bryan
text: And they do not lie off. If they are galleys, they are gone. That is the seamanship I have.

speaker: margery_pell
text: The yard has it otherwise already. Forty galleys, and Plymouth taken.

speaker: will_kemp
text: There. I asked which, and the yard has chosen.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Plymouth is not in the court post. Leave Plymouth in the yard.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Four galleys, and four places, and a church on a hill. That is the account I mean to keep.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: And the laugh, which I have had. The old woman is done.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Good. Let the paying be the paying, and not this.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It was the best Saturday of the month until the box. I am not mixing the play into the news.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Four, then. I asked which, and the court post has answered.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Galleys burn and go. They cannot lie on that coast. The yard has not heard me.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: The laugh is had. Let the names wait their turn.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then the names stay after. Come to the book when the laugh is done.
